messages:
maya: hey folks, i'm maya (infra team) day 1. trying to access a customer sandbox in europe but i can't list KMS keys or start a VM in europe-west3. console shows permission denied. who handles GCP project bindings?

onboard-bot: welcome @maya! for GCP access questions tag @diego (infra) or @leo (platform). onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/gcp-access

diego: hi @maya. can you paste the project id and the exact console error? quick checks: `gcloud auth list` and `gcloud projects get-iam-policy PROJECT_ID`

maya: project id is redwood-customer-sbx-eu. console error (screenshot pasted): "You do not have permission to access this resource (or it may have been deleted)." CLI error when listing KMS keys: ```Error: PERMISSION_DENIED: The caller does not have permission```

diego: sounds like missing roles. two common ones for your tasks: `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` for VMs and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` or `roles/cloudkms.admin` for KMS. however org policy sometimes restricts KMS keyring locations — which keyring are you trying to access?

maya: trying keyring `redwood-keyring-eu` in location `europe-west3`. when I run `gcloud kms keys list --keyring redwood-keyring-eu --location europe-west3 --project redwood-customer-sbx-eu` I get the PERMISSION_DENIED above.

leo: adding context: for customer sandboxes we often restrict direct key access and require using a service account bound to a workload identity pool. If you need temporary access for onboarding we'll either add you to the `project-editors@redwood` group or create a short-lived access grant. Security prefers granting the least privilege role rather than full editor.

security: @leo correct. please don't request project-owner. For KMS operations grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` at the key or keyring level and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the service account if you need to impersonate. Also confirm there are no VPC Service Controls restricting cross-project access.

diego: can you run and paste the output of `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-customer-sbx-eu --format=json` (redact tokens) or just confirm whether your user is in any IAM binding? If you can't run that, include a screenshot in the ticket.

maya: I can't run it due to permission error. opened INFRA-2022 and attached screenshot + my caller id: `user:maya@redwood.com, account: 333333333333`

leo: thanks — INFRA-2022 received. next steps: (1) infra will check for org-policy/VPC-SC blocks, (2) if clear, we'll add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the specific keyring and `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` as needed for VM tests, (3) if policy blocks exist we'll propose a scoped service-account workaround.

onboard-bot: INFRA-2022 created and assigned to `infra` queue. Typical SLA: 1-2 business days. If you need something immediately, mention `priority:onboarding` in the ticket.

maya: can someone confirm whether eu sandboxes are behind VPC-SC? don't want to request roles that will still be blocked.

diego: will check org policies. if VPC-SC is enforced you need access from an allowed perimeter or a dedicated service perimeter exception — that's slower and security will need to approve. I'll ping security to triage.

security: confirmed: redwood-customer-sbx-eu is in a restricted perimeter for external services. we'll review INFRA-2022 and either (A) add your user to a temporary access group that has perimeter access, or (B) we give you a temp service account to run tests. Please include the exact test commands you need in the ticket.

maya: perfect, i'll add the command list and timelines in INFRA-2022. for now i'll test in us-central1. thanks everyone! :wave:
